In view of the Telangana State Police programme “Arrive Alive – A Campaign for Safer Roads in Telangana” at Shri Kotla Vijaya Bhaskar Reddy Indoor Stadium, Yousufguda, Hyderabad, on 12-01-2026. A large gathering of the general public and college students is expected to participate in the programme. In view of the movement of participants and their vehicles, moderate traffic congestion is anticipated in and around the venue. To avoid inconvenience, commuters are advised to avoid travel towards Shri Kotla Vijaya Bhaskar Reddy Indoor Stadium and to use the following alternate routes.

DIVERSION POINTS FOR GENERAL PUBLIC ON 12.01.2026 FROM 2.30 PM TO 6 PM:

1.Traffic coming from Maitrivanam junction towards Yousufguda basti, Rahamathnagar, Karmikanagar and Borabanda bus stop will be diverted at Yousufguda Basti towards-Krishnakanth park-GTS Temple- Kalyan Nagar- Mothi nagar- Borabanda Bus stop.

2.Traffic coming from Maitrivanam junction and proceeding towards Jubilee Hills checkpost via Yousufguda check post and Madhapur side will be diverted at Yousufguda basti towards RBI Quarters- Krishna Nagar junction- Jubilee Hills checkpost. 

3.Traffic coming from Jubilee hills Checkpost and Venkatagiri going towards Kotla Vijaya Bhasker Reddy Stadium will be diverted at Krishna nagar Junction towards Srinagar Colony -Panjagutta.

4.Traffic coming from Borabanda bus stop and proceeding towards Karmikanagar, Rahamathnagar, Yousufguda Check post will be diverted at Prime Garden Function Hall, Sri Ram Nagar X Roads towards Midland Bakery-GTS Colony- Kalyan nagar junction- Vengalraonagar- Umesh chandra statue U Turn – ICICI U turn – Maitrivanam junction. 

The Citizens are requested to take note of the above traffic advisory and co-operate with the Hyderabad Traffic Police.
Parking for general public: 
1.TGSP Battalion Ground, Yoousufguda, Hyderabad.

STOP STEALING THE SUBWAY: BILLIONS DIVERTED, COMMUTERS BETRAYED

Every day Filipinos rot in traffic while the administration loot the very project meant to save us from it. The so-called “Project of the Century” is not delayed by engineering—it is being sabotaged by corruption. 🛑

The Metro Manila Subway, which should have been completed by 2028, is now crawling toward delay because Official Development Assistance (ODA) funds are being deliberately siphoned off to flood control and other high-kickback projects.

Follow the money:
📍 2024: ₱252 BILLION in ODA funds diverted
📍 2025: ₱157 BILLION more diverted

This was supposed to be the BBM administration’s flagship legacy—a finished subway by 2028 that would ease the daily suffering of millions. Instead, it has become another feeding trough for the corrupt. 

THE PRICE OF CORRUPTION:

The project costs ₱488 BILLION. Because of these delays, the Filipino people will be forced to pay an EXTRA ₱100 BILLION—money stolen from hospitals, classrooms, and social services. 

We are paying for a subway we cannot ride, while the funds meant to complete it vanish into flood control ghost projects and dubious contracts. 

This is betrayal.

Commuters deserve justice.
The Filipino people demand accountability. 🇵🇭
